_comment: MC-030 for a person filing without a lawyer: the case caption first (they copy it from their court papers), then who they are, then the statement itself. The date beside the signature fills itself; the signature is signed by hand on the printed line.

case_number.subtitle: It is printed at the top of the court papers in your case.

court_county.text: Which county is the court in?
court_county.subtitle: Just the county name, for example Monterey.

plaintiff_petitioner_name.text: Who is the plaintiff or petitioner in the case?
plaintiff_petitioner_name.subtitle: Write the name exactly as it appears on your court papers.

defendant_respondent_name.text: Who is the defendant or respondent in the case?
defendant_respondent_name.subtitle: Write the name exactly as it appears on your court papers.

declarant_name.text: What is the full name of the person making this declaration?
declarant_name.subtitle: This is usually you. A witness giving their own statement uses their name.

declaration_text.text: What do you want to tell the court?
declaration_text.subtitle: Write only what you know first-hand, in your own words. Include dates, places and what happened.

combines.question: What is your name and mailing address?

autofill.why: The date beside the signature is the day the declaration is made, and the form already knows it.
